name: Sophia
summary: Sophia is a social humanoid from Hanson Robotics, best known for media appearances and talks since 2016. It uses Frubber skin to show facial expressions and can sit on a wheeled mobile base. It is mainly a technology demonstrator, not a work robot.
hands: Arms and hands with 15 DoF each side, touch sensors in the fingers.
sensors: Intel RealSense chest camera, two 720p eye cameras, microphone, joint force sensors, finger touch sensors, IMU.
compute: 3 GHz Intel i7, 32 GB RAM, integrated GPU.
highlights: Activated on 14 February 2016; first public appearance at SXSW in March 2016.
Granted Saudi Arabian citizenship in October 2017.
Named UNDP Innovation Champion for Asia and the Pacific in November 2017.
caveats: Primarily a technology demonstrator for media and events, not a work robot.
